core_principles: Raw blocks, minimal ornamentation, utilitarian feel.
High contrast: Stark black/white with Signal Red for critical review items.

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: The Control Room Grid (tight gaps, dense data).
layout_and_spacing.container_padding: Generous on wrappers (p-8 to p-12), tight inside tables (p-2).
layout_and_spacing.borders: Thick 2px borders for main containers to give a brutalist edge.
layout_and_spacing.shadows: Hard offset shadows (e.g., 4px 4px 0px 0px rgba(0,0,0,1)) for interactive elements like buttons and active cards.

data_table.borders: Subtle zebra striping (bg-gray-50 for even rows), solid 1px bottom border on rows.
data_table.actions: Hover-only row actions or sticky right column.
data_table.highlighting: Rows needing review MUST have a thick left border (border-l-4 border-red-600) and a subtle red background tint (bg-red-50) to instantly draw attention.

buttons.primary: Square or very slightly rounded (rounded-sm), black background, white text, hard offset shadow on hover.
buttons.secondary: Transparent background, 2px black border, black text.

inputs.style: Square edges, 2px border on focus, high contrast text.

file_upload.style: Large dashed border area, light gray background, turns darker on drag over. Centered icon.

icons.library: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for dense, professional looks.

images.description: Abstract black and white geometric pattern for login page backdrop.

accessibility_and_interactions.hover_states: Must significantly change contrast (e.g., black to gray-800).
accessibility_and_interactions.test_ids: All buttons, inputs, and table rows must have data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard HTML + Tailwind for structural layouts, and customize Shadcn components heavily to match the Swiss Brutalist aesthetic.
Install and use 'lucide-react' or '@phosphor-icons/react' for icons.
Ensure the dashboard provides a clear visual distinction between approved items and items needing review (red highlights).
Implement threshold adjustable inputs (e.g., margin %, operational cost) at the top or in a side panel.
Implement file upload drag & drop zone clearly.
DO NOT use Inter for headings. Use Cabinet Grotesk or a suitable bold sans-serif.
DO NOT use soft drop shadows. Use hard offset shadows or pure flat design.
